name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US, Mexico and Bolivia lost measles elimination on 17 Nov; US cases reach 5,412, the most since 1991
state: The Pan American Health Organization confirmed on 17 Nov that the United States, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after more than 12 months of continuous transmission (Contagion Live). CDC counted 5,412 confirmed US cases in 2026 as of 12 Nov and six measles-related deaths, against three in all of 2025 (Contagion Live; Honolulu Star-Advertiser). Loss of elimination meets Watch; searches on 25 Nov found no multi-country rise in deaths or polio or diphtheria resurgence, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Measles spreads easily among unvaccinated people. The NHS advises checking that you and your children have had two MMR doses, and UKHSA and FCDO travel advice cover outbreaks abroad.
rubric_hit: Watch: loss of elimination status (US, Mexico, Bolivia, 17 Nov); no multi-country surge in deaths

sources.title: Contagion Live — It's official: US loses measles elimination status
Honolulu Star-Advertiser — CDC confirms 6 measles-related deaths in 2026

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
